name: OSS_USAGE_CHARGE_COMPONENTS
description: Following table is used to capture usage charge component rated by fusion pricing application.

columns.name: USAGE_CHARGE_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for usage charge component.

columns.name: USAGE_CHARGE_COMPONENT_PUID
columns.description: Alternate identifier for usage charge component.

columns.name: PARTITION_KEY
columns.description: Unique Identifier for the Partition.

columns.name: USAGE_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key usage chage id of usage charge.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Tracks the batch id for given usage charge component.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Field used to capture primary key of usage event.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
columns.description: Usage charge component for source subscription.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Usage charge for source subscription product.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: charge component sequence number of source system.

columns.name: CHARGE_CURRENCY
columns.description: currency code of usage charge component.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: unit price of usage charge component.

columns.name: EXTENDED_AMOUNT
columns.description: calculated price of usage charge component.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT
columns.description: Field used to capture source system price  element.

columns.name: PRICE_ELEMENT_USAGE
columns.description: source system price element usage.

columns.name: PRICING_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: charge component  pricing source type.

columns.name: PRICING_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: charge component  pricing source indentifier.

columns.name: COVERAGE_EXTENDED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Coverage Extended amount.

columns.name: EXPLANATION
columns.description: Explanation about the charge calculation.

columns.name: EXPLANATION_MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Explanation Message Name for the charge calculation.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_CURRENCY
columns.description: The Currency corresponding to the Subscription.

columns.name: SUBSCR_CURRENCY_UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: The Unit Price associated with Subscription Currency.

columns.name: SUBSCR_CURRENCY_COV_EXT_AMT
columns.description: The amount after applying the Currency conversion.

columns.name: SUBSCR_CURRENCY_EXT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Subscription Currency Extended Amount.

columns.name: PCT_OF_COMPARISON_ELEMENT
columns.description: Percent of comparison element.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to denote whether tax is included or not.

columns.name: ROLLUP_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to denote whether amount roll up needs to be done or not.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
